_comment: LEVEL 4 (component, frontend): accessible modal with confirm/cancel variants.
name: comp-modal
description: Accessible modal + confirm dialog: focus trap, ESC close, overlay click. No extra deps.
notes: Usage: <Modal open={open} onClose={close} title="Confirm">...</Modal>. Confirm variant: <ConfirmDialog open title message onConfirm onCancel />. ESC + overlay click close by default.
